blocks.rationale: The TRAIN NDA pairs consistently show that disclosure permission depends on a coupled recipient-and-condition rule: employees, agents, representatives, consultants, and professional advisers may receive information when the stated need-to-know or confidentiality conditions can be met. A focused classifier avoids the unrelated remuneration reader that failed on every ContractNLI view.
